title: categories.features
description: Request the resolved feature definitions (own + inherited) for a category. The result is cacheable by the returned revision; a category.changed event invalidates it. This object validates the request payload; the response shape ({category_id, revision, features:[ResolvedFeature]}) is documented in $defs for consumers.

category_id.description: ID of the category whose feature schema to resolve.

ResolvedFeature.description: One resolved feature in the response 'features' array. Fed to stapel-attributes' coerce_feature_defs / FeatureDef. Every property of the canon (stapel-attributes docs/feature-def.schema.json $defs.FeatureDef) except 'config' — which has its own per-type shape there — MUST be present here; tests/test_resolved_feature_contract.py gates that. show_at_title, show_as_badge and translate carry the title/badge projections attributes' dto_to_dao builds; 'rules' carries requiredness and visibility, without which the whole category silently reverts to static 'mandatory'.

slug.description: Payload key the feature is submitted under.

mandatory.description: Whether a value is STATICALLY required; conditional requirement comes from 'rules'.

show_at_title.description: Whether the value is shown in the listing title.

show_as_badge.description: Whether the value is shown as a badge.

rules.description: Conditional rules over sibling values, in stapel-attributes' closed grammar ($defs.Rule of the canon). Default: [] (no rules — requiredness is 'mandatory', the feature is always visible).

description.description: Help text under the field; translation key or literal. Default: "" (no help text).

example.description: Placeholder text; translation key or literal. Default: "" (no placeholder).

default.description: Initial form value in DTO 'value' shape (for a select, a list of option codes); any JSON. Default: null (the form starts empty).

hints.description: Notices rendered with the field; titles and contents are translation keys or literals. Default: [] (no notices).

group.description: Form section this feature belongs to; sections order by first appearance. Default: "" (the unnamed leading section).

config.description: Type-specific config (merged with type defaults), with a 'type' discriminator.
